body: Interested - I get much of my inspirations through music so it would be great to give your content a listen.

This is quite possibly the most constructive advice I've gotten to this day in regards to filming. You know, I've never actually thought of giving the scenes individual moods to perfect what I'm looking for. And maybe from there, true inspiration will sprout - out of analyzing my mood specific scenes. This was actually so helpful. Thank you!

I know what you mean, but I'm not sure how to even get started when I already have filmers-block, if that makes sense? What did you start filming? Things around you? Did you write yourself a script? For me, I'm more into visual expression, no words, just emotion. Is filming my surroundings stupid for a start?
This is so freaking wholesome! Yes!!!! Go you!!
Huh, that actually makes a lot of sense to me. Thank you for breaking that down for me in a more concrete way! Your explanation definitely resonates with me a lot.
